testcase.name: a hinted response after the reveal stays priced by the reveal
self report writes self-reported evidence, advances the session and is idempotent
an incorrect response after the reveal is priced as incorrect-after-reveal
a plan written by another planner version is replanned instead of continued
a hinted incorrect response is priced as incorrect-after-hint
a hinted correct response is priced as correct-after-hint
the default plan is stamped by V2 and never carries the retired V1 version string
a plan from the current planner version is kept as today's plan
hint count reaches the prediction audit outcome
a correct response after the answer was revealed is priced as post-reveal
